    • aprilTagFieldLayout

      public edu.wpi.first.apriltag.AprilTagFieldLayout aprilTagFieldLayout

    • largeVariance

      public final double largeVariance
      A very large variance used to down-weight or effectively reject unreliable measurements.

      Unit: variance in the same units as the underlying state (e.g., m^2 or rad^2). Default: 1e6.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • defaultAmbiguityThreshold

      public double defaultAmbiguityThreshold
      Maximum allowable multi-tag solution ambiguity (unitless), above which the estimate is rejected. Lower is stricter. Typical: ~0.10–0.25.

    • defaultYawDiffThreshold

      public double defaultYawDiffThreshold
      Maximum allowable absolute yaw delta (degrees) between vision-implied yaw and the current gyro yaw before rejecting the measurement (for single-tag low-area shots).

    • tagAreaThresholdForYawCheck

      public double tagAreaThresholdForYawCheck
      Minimum tag area (in normalized image units, as produced by your pipeline) required to engage the yaw cross-check logic. Below this area, yaw tends to be noisy.

    • tagMinAreaForSingleTagMegatag

      public double tagMinAreaForSingleTagMegatag
      Minimum tag area (image units) required for single-tag Megatag usage. Single-tag estimates below this are often ill-conditioned.

    • defaultZThreshold

      public double defaultZThreshold
      Maximum allowable |Z| difference (meters) between vision and expected robot height before rejecting the measurement. Helps filter solutions with incorrect floor alignment.

    • maxGyroYawErrorDegs

      public double maxGyroYawErrorDegs
      Maximum allowable gyro yaw error (degrees) for accepting a vision measurement.

    • highYawLookbackS

      public final double highYawLookbackS
      Look-back window (seconds) for computing recent yaw velocity. If the absolute yaw rate exceeded highYawVelocityRadS within this window, time-sync may be unreliable and the measurement can be rejected.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • highYawVelocityRadS

      public final double highYawVelocityRadS
      Yaw-rate threshold (radians/second) considered "high". Above this, measurement rejection is advisable because rolling-shutter/pipeline latencies can bias the pose.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • maxTranslationJumpMeters

      public double maxTranslationJumpMeters
      Maximum allowable translation jump (meters) between the odometry pose and vision measurement. Larger jumps will reset odometry instead of fusing.

    • maxYawJumpDegrees

      public double maxYawJumpDegrees
      Maximum allowable yaw jump (degrees) between the odometry pose and vision measurement. Larger jumps will reset odometry instead of fusing.

    • simAvgErrorPx

      public double simAvgErrorPx
      Average pixel error to simulate in vision measurements (pixels).
